Customer ko business ka pata chalne se purchase tak kya hota hai? 🛒

Sales funnel is journey ko samajhne ka ek model hai. Discovery → interest aur evaluation → purchase. Real journeys mein customer wapas aa sakta hai ya steps repeat kar sakta hai.

Har stage par alag questions hote hain: product kya hai, total price kitna hai, delivery kab hogi aur seller par trust kar sakte hain?

Jahan log rukte hain use track karo. Ek clear problem identify karke chhota change test karo.

Aapke customers sabse zyada kis step par rukte hain?

sets.caption:
Business owner har chhoti cheez khud check kare—ye long-term mein mushkil ho sakta hai. 📋

SOP (Standard Operating Procedure) repeat hone wale kaam ke clear steps likhne ka tareeka hai.

Order packing example:
1. Items check karo
2. Safely pack karo
3. Label verify karo
4. Dispatch mark karo

Responsible person, quality checks aur problem aaye toh next step clear rakho. Team ke saath real order par test karo; process badle toh document update karo.

SOP training aur judgment ko support karta hai.
